address: 8F, 33 Wyndham Street, Central, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Heimat is German for homeland. After working in some prestigious kitchens, German chef-owner Peter Find reinterprets classics from his home country with sophistication, quality ingredients and dexterous care. The tasting menu takes diners on a journey across Germany with flavours from his childhood memories. Ask for the wine or juice pairing to accompany the food. And who can resist the gummy bear trolley at the end?...
